fields.name: Timeline
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D99430 fills the 16 bytes from the value of ecl::PlayersInTimelineGlobalComponent for the player (timeline instance id) and sets the flag at +0x10; bg3.exe+0x1D9BBC0 compares old and new entries by these two qwords and counts players per Guid.

fields.name: HasTimeline
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D99430 clears it first and sets it when the player has a timeline; bg3.exe+0x1D9BBC0 tests it before using the Guid (std::optional<Guid> pattern).

fields.name: Time
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D9A490 stores the time argument of the update here; bg3.exe+0x1D9BBC0 compares it as a double (the earlier one wins among equal priorities; initial best 0x47EFFFFFE0000000 = FLT_MAX as double).

fields.name: Priority
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D9A490 stores 0..3 (result of bg3.exe+0x1D99430: 0 or 2 by timeline state, else 1, 3 when the player has no entity); bg3.exe+0x1D9BBC0 picks the player with the lowest value (initial best 4) and compares it between old and new state.

fields.name: Players
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D99C70 (ecl::sound::TimelinePrioritySystem update; registration bg3.exe+0x733260 lists the component as written) copies the map: keys are shorts (compared as *(short*)(keys + i*2)), values are copied with stride 0x28 from +0x30, count from +0x2C. bg3.exe+0x1D9BBC0 writes the new map back (alloc of count * 0x28). Probe: 1 key, 1 value.

fields.name: ActivePlayer
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D9BBC0 writes a short at +0x40: the key of the entry with the lowest Priority, then earliest Time. Probe: 1.

fields.name: SharedTimeline
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D9BBC0 writes a byte at +0x42: true when all entries with a timeline name exactly one timeline and at least two players are in it. Probe: 0 (single player).

open_questions: Exact meaning of the Priority values 0..3 (they come from eoc::TimelineDataComponent state bytes at +0x78 in bg3.exe+0x1D99430); names of ActivePlayer/SharedTimeline are descriptive, not from symbols.
Timeline + HasTimeline is most likely std::optional<Guid>.
PlayerId is int16_t in Script Extender (Base/ExposedTypes.h).
